column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# The hook and the command share the artifact id `scan` (hooks/scan.sh, commands/scan.md);
# they resolve by kind and own different territories — the hook denies a secret on its
# way to disk, the command sweeps for one already committed.

column5: PreToolUse Write/Edit/MultiEdit, or Bash with a write target (heredoc body, echo/printf argument), whose new text matches a high-confidence secret shape (AWS key id, private-key block, GitHub/Slack token, Google API key, Stripe live key, assigned secret literal)
invoked as /secret-scanning:scan [path-or-diff]; the user asks whether a secret is already in the tree or a diff
writing config or .env, wiring an API client, pasting a key, or reading a diff for leaked credentials
PostToolUse on a Write/Edit/Read, or a Bash command writing up to 8 files under the project root, whose file carries zero-width, bidi-override or tag-block codepoints
